## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows | `whatsgrep-windows-x64.exe` |
| macOS | `whatsgrep-macos-arm64` (Apple silicon) · `whatsgrep-macos-x64` (Intel) |
| Linux | `whatsgrep-linux-x64` · `whatsgrep-linux-arm64` |

Run it with `whatsgrep ui`. Needs Chrome, Chromium, Edge or Brave. Not code-signed, so macOS and Windows will ask you to confirm the first launch.

[Setup steps](https://github.com/ankit-ksh/whatsgrep#install) · [Changelog](https://github.com/ankit-ksh/whatsgrep/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · `SHA256SUMS.txt` has the checksums.
